answer: Watch the clock, not just the words. Each key's submission times, latency patterns and idle gaps form a rhythm as personal as a quill hand. Clones run by one operator tend to fire in tight bursts from the same scheduler, so the network clusters keys whose timing moves in lockstep and splits a single reward among each cluster. An honest agent stays its own island, while a farm's thousand keys collapse into one, and the canyon between its costs and its payout only widens.
